# pai tasks

Same as task

```
pai tasks <command>
```

Same as `pai task`: Cross-session task list: list, add, dispatch, done.

Shortcut for `pai task`.

```sh
pai tasks list
pai tasks add "Fix the login bug" --owner my-app
```

### pai tasks projects

Show which projects can receive tasks, and create missing ones

```
pai tasks projects [options]
```

Show which projects can receive tasks, and create missing ones.

Show which sessions can be given work from the tracker, and create the missing projects

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--create NAMES` | string | — | Create tracker projects for these session names (several values allowed) |
| `--create-all` | flag | — | Create a project for every session that has none |

```sh
pai task projects
pai task projects --create-all
```

See also: `pai task list`

### pai tasks list

List open tasks

```
pai tasks list [options]
```

List open tasks.

List open tasks on the bus

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--owner PROJECT` | string | — | Only tasks owned by this PAI project |
| `--due DATE` | string | — | Only tasks due on or before this ISO date |
| `--today` | flag | — | Shorthand for --due <today> |
| `--routed` | flag | — | Hide tasks with no resolved owner |
| `--limit N` | string | — | Maximum tasks to show |

```sh
pai task list
pai task list --today --owner my-app
```

See also: `pai task add`, `pai task projects`

### pai tasks add

Add a task to the list

```
pai tasks add TITLE [options]
```

Add a task to the list.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TITLE` | yes | What the task is, in a few words |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--owner PROJECT` | string | — | PAI project that owns this (adds a pai: label) |
| `--body TEXT` | string | — | Full procedure and reasoning — not just a restatement of the title |
| `--due WHEN` | string | — | Due date: ISO, natural language, or a recurrence ("every monday at 9") |
| `--priority P` | string | — | p1 (highest) … p4 (default) |
| `--url URL` | string | — | Reference — prefer a hook:// URL over a file path |
| `--into SUB_PROJECT` | string | — | File into this sub-project under the bus root, creating it if absent |

```sh
pai task add "Fix the login bug"
pai task add "Write release notes" --owner my-app --due tomorrow
```

See also: `pai task dispatch`, `pai task list`

### pai tasks dispatch

Hand open tasks to the sessions that own them

```
pai tasks dispatch [options]
```

Hand open tasks to the sessions that own them.

Hand open tasks to the PAI sessions that own them

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--owner PROJECT` | string | — | Only dispatch tasks for this project |
| `--today` | flag | — | Only tasks due today or overdue |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Report what would happen without contacting any session |
| `--no-spawn` | flag | — | Never launch a session; skip owners that are not running |

```sh
pai task dispatch --dry-run
pai task dispatch --owner my-app --no-spawn
```

See also: `pai task poll`, `pai task add`

### pai tasks poll

Run one scheduler tick: dispatch what is due and report

```
pai tasks poll [options]
```

Run one scheduler tick: dispatch what is due and report.

One scheduler tick: dispatch what is due, check what is running, report

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Show what would happen without touching anything |

```sh
pai task poll --dry-run
pai task poll
```

See also: `pai task schedule`, `pai task dispatch`

### pai tasks schedule

Install, remove or check the timer that runs the scheduler

```
pai tasks schedule <command>
```

Install, remove or check the timer that runs the scheduler.

Install, remove or inspect the launchd agent that ticks the scheduler

```sh
pai task schedule status
pai task schedule install --interval 900
```

See also: `pai task config`, `pai task poll`

#### pai tasks schedule install

Install the timer (default: every 15 minutes)

```
pai tasks schedule install [options]
```

Install the timer (default: every 15 minutes).

Install the scheduler tick (default: every 15 minutes)

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--interval SECS` | string | — | Seconds between ticks |

```sh
pai task schedule install
pai task schedule install --interval 600
```

See also: `pai task schedule uninstall`

#### pai tasks schedule uninstall

Remove the timer

```

```

Remove the timer.

Remove the scheduler agent

```sh

pai task schedule status
```

See also: `pai task schedule status`, `pai task schedule install`

#### pai tasks schedule status

Show whether the timer is installed and running

```

```

Show whether the timer is installed and running.

Show whether the scheduler agent is installed and loaded

```sh

pai task schedule status
```

See also: `pai task schedule uninstall`

### pai tasks config

Show or change task settings

```
pai tasks config [options]
```

Show or change task settings.

View or change task bus settings without running the full setup wizard

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--token` | flag | — | Prompt for the Todoist API token (input is hidden) |
| `--from-env` | flag | — | Adopt the token from TODOIST_API_KEY in the environment |
| `--project ID` | string | — | Tracker project ID that roots the bus (an ID, never a name) |
| `--findings ID` | string | — | Section ID for the findings inbox |
| `--timeout SECS` | string | — | Seconds a single dispatch may take |
| `--auto-dispatch BOOL` | string | — | Hand tasks to owning sessions automatically (true/false) |
| `--disable` | flag | — | Turn the task bus off without discarding its settings |

```sh
pai task config
pai task config --auto-dispatch true
```

See also: `pai task archive`, `pai task schedule`

### pai tasks archive

Save a task's discussion into the project notes

```
pai tasks archive ID [options]
```

Save a task's discussion into the project notes.

Save a task's discussion into the owning project's notes, without completing it

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Task id (see: pai task list) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--quiet` | flag | — | Print nothing (for hook and webhook callers) |
| `--no-notify` | flag | — | Do not tell the owning session where the file landed |

```sh
pai task archive 123456
pai task archive 123456 --quiet
```

See also: `pai task done`, `pai task config`

### pai tasks done

Mark a task complete

```
pai tasks done ID [options]
```

Mark a task complete.

Mark a task complete on the tracker, keeping its discussion

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Task id (see: pai task list) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-archive` | flag | — | Complete without saving the comment thread |

```sh
pai task done 123456
pai task done 123456 --no-archive
```

See also: `pai task archive`
